title: MY Museum

services.name: Toddler Gymnastics
services.desc: Join us on Wednesdays as we partner with Shea’s Gymnastics!Toddlers will learn about the basics of gymnastics through games and movement in this fun and engaging Caregiver & Me program.Recommended for children ages 2 through 5. 📆 Day: Every Wednesday⏰ Time: 10:15-10:45am🎟️ Fee: Included with daily admission FREE

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: During a 90-minute field trip, children can explore our unique hands-on exhibits about a variety of subjects including STEM, art, music, theater, health, and everyday role-playing. We require one adult to every five children e.g. 25 students would require 5 adults. Field Trips are 90 minutes long and available for booking Mon-Fri based on availability and size of group.
